most_supported_bottlenecks: Reliable grounding of the actual contact reference in current pixels, especially small/oblique arrow and finger end.
Keeping current visual state consistent across structured fields and using it to constrain action instead of stale historical descriptions.
Camera/action causality and selection of appropriate actuator; head-to-wrist confusion observed.
Fine image-to-robot geometry and step size remain unvalidated, rather than proven universally absent.
preserved_subcapabilities: Six explicit robot directions encoded correctly in six isolated requests.
Coarse visibility and rightward position judged correctly under simple prompts on the tested shifted frame.
Correct visual-state oracle changed three baseline actions from +X to -Y without an explicit desired axis.
not_yet_isolated: Given accurate point coordinates, pure above/below-left/right comparison.
Object identification versus coordinate localization versus relation computation in the same marked scene.
General image-to-body transformation under different camera poses.
Correct mm magnitude or calibrated physical contact.
Quantization, model size, sampling parameters, or image resolution as causal factors.
confounds: Latest get_view hard gate demands precise contact localization in head view; no get_view progress monitor. Repeated head search is partly program design, not an uncontaminated model ability test.
Actual head angles stay below commanded goals even after 47-65 seconds. Executor stops head sends after final interpolation; native SDK physical cause remains unconfirmed.
Independent service task deepcopy/write race caused final HTTP 503; reproduced with fake. Not a cause of earlier perception errors.
Most tests use the same correlated shifted-panel frames; source reports are copied/summarized elsewhere. Do not sum percentages across reports as independent samples.
Actual endpoint is Inferact/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4; no same-prompt BF16/FP8 or other-model comparison establishes quantization as cause.
